name: Staff.rip
description: AI coding agent that lets teams describe code changes in plain language and ship them. Works across frontend, backend, microservices, and infra. Can be hosted or self-hosted with agent running locally so code never leaves machine. Opens AI-assisted development to designers, PMs, and clients without requiring git or CLI knowledge.
community_quotes: AI coding tools today are either 'send your whole codebase to someone else's cloud' (Cursor, Lovable) or 'engineers-only CLI' (Claude Code, Aider). Designers, PMs, and agency clients are stuck filing tickets and waiting.
Giving the capability to ship to a broader audience, the way to empower codebases with the strength of the community
The 'plain language to shipped code' framing is the wedge for ai-assisted shipping.

name: BNA Code
description: CLI AI agent that builds full-stack mobile apps from terminal. Users run npx bna-code, choose stack (Expo React Native, Swift, Kotlin with Supabase/Convex/Firebase backend), describe app idea, and BNA launches frontend and backend agents to build mobile apps with authentication, realtime database, APIs, UI components, and native device features access.
community_quotes: There are a lot of tools to vibe-code mobile apps, but they all miss something fundamental. They build apps in the browser, inside a sandbox. But real mobile apps run on real devices with access to the camera, microphone, geolocation, push notifications.
So we moved mobile development to where it belongs: Your device. Your terminal.
Just one command in your terminal. Go grab a coffee ☕ and come back to a full-stack real mobile app in favorite stack with full ownership of code and no vendor lock-in.

name: ClawTick
description: Cloud scheduler built specifically for AI agents. Schedule LangChain, CrewAI, or webhook tasks with one CLI command. Provides built-in monitoring, failure alerts, automatic retries, and execution logs without managing servers or writing cron infrastructure. CLI for agents, dashboard for humans. Designed to be agent-friendly with minimal tokens for programmatic scheduling.
community_quotes: I built this because I was running AI agents that needed to fire on a schedule — daily reports, periodic data checks, automated follow-ups.
CLI for agents, dashboard for humans is the cleanest way to position this — the moment scheduling has to happen, you want CLI; the moment you want to know what fired and what failed, you want UI.
This is the layer I didn't realize I needed. The 'one command, zero infra' framing matters because most agent-cron approaches assume you already have a scheduler running somewhere.

name: WOZCODE
description: Efficiency layer plugin for Claude Code that reduces token costs by up to 50% and improves performance. Replaces Claude's native tools with WozSearch and WozEdit for more efficient context handling. Official Anthropic-approved plugin that installs in two commands and works across CLI, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and other Claude Code environments.
community_quotes: Half of our tokens were being burned on erroneous reads and re-reads after edits. Paying a premium for productivity is one thing. Paying a premium for wasted tokens is incredibly frustrating.
WOZCODE is an official Claude Code plugin, approved by Anthropic. It works anywhere you use Claude Code.
In vanilla Claude Code, a simple 'find and edit 3 files' takes 12+ calls. WOZCODE collapses that to 2 calls. Context stays small, so every step that follows is cheaper and faster.
